headline: School Committee to review policies on E-bikes, Artificial Intelligence, PROTECT Act, and contracts for food services and supplies.
summary: The Methuen School Committee will review staff reports, old business on redistricting and wellness procedures, and new policies including the PROTECT Act, E-bike safety, and Artificial Intelligence. It will also act on finance items such as contract awards and FY27 grant awards.

GUIDELINES
 
FOR
 
PUBLIC
 
COMMENT
 
Here
 
are
 
the
 
general
 
rules
 
for
 
the
 
Committee’s
 
Public
 
Comment
 
period:
 
 
1.
 
Public
 
Comment
 
shall
 
generally
 
follow
 
the
 
opening
 
of
 
the
 
meeting.
  
The
 
Committee
 
reserves
 
the
 
right
 
to
 
rearrange
 
its
 
agenda
 
to
 
accommodate
 
scheduled
 
presenters.
 
 
2.
 
Any
 
citizen
 
wishing
 
to
 
speak
 
before
 
the
 
Committee
 
shall
 
identify
 
him/herself
 
by
 
name
 
and
 
address
 
and
 
shall
 
speak
 
for
 
no
 
longer
 
than
 
5
 
minutes
 
(per
 
S.C.
 
Policy
 
BEDH).
  
No
 
citizen
 
may
 
speak
 
more
 
than
 
once
 
without
 
the
 
Chair's
 
permission.
  
All
 
citizens
 
shall
 
speak
 
to
 
the
 
full
 
Committee
 
through
 
the
 
Chair
 
and
 
shall
 
not
 
address
 
individual
 
members
 
or
 
administrators.
 
 
3.
 
Individuals
 
may
 
address
 
topics
 
on
 
the
 
agenda,
 
items
 
specified
 
for
 
Public
 
Comment,
 
or
 
items
 
within
 
the
 
School
 
Committee's
 
scope
 
of
 
responsibility.
  
The
 
Chair
 
shall
 
rule
 
out
 
of
 
order
 
any
 
individual
 
who
 
fails
 
to
 
honor
 
the
 
guidelines
 
or
 
who
 
addresses
 
a
 
matter
 
inappropriate
 
for
 
Public
 
Comment.
